publicIdentity.tagline: A father-and-son studio building a free browser adventure of alien creatures, living worlds and meaningful choices.
publicIdentity.about:
Mythical Void began in Ireland as a father-and-son project: Kevin and his nine-year-old son asking what imagination and generative AI tools could make possible. The result is a free browser adventure where players hatch strange alien creatures, cross six living realms, restore their guardians and decide what Project Beacon should tell Earth.

We are building Mythical as an AI-first, human-governed independent studio. AI helps us explore and create; people remain responsible for safety, story, public claims and important player choices. Selected public NASA material can appear in optional STEM discovery moments. NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.

Play: https://mythicalvoid.com/play/
Our story: https://mythicalvoid.com/studio/

assets.coverRule: Preview the final crop before use. It is AI-generated marketing artwork inspired by the creature engine, not gameplay.

firstPublicAction.preferredRoute: Kevin may first publish the founder story from his existing professional profile; an official company Page is optional for that first post.

channels.creationRoute: Use a Google Account Kevin already controls to create a channel with the Mythical Void public name. Use channel permissions for future helpers; never share the Google password.

assets.bannerRule: Do not improvise a stretched crop. Approve a dedicated desktop, television and phone-safe banner before channel launch.

releaseGate.reason: The channel may be reserved, but no trailer or gameplay-led launch should use the withdrawn weak visual pack.

ownership.rule: Record only the canonical public URL and named roles in the repository. Keep account addresses, recovery details and credentials outside it.

moderation.firstPostCoverage: Kevin or a named adult reviews public responses during the first 48 hours after publication.
moderation.childMessageRule: Do not continue a private conversation that appears to be with a child. Do not request a name, age, school, location, image, voice or design.

kevinChecklist: Choose whether the first founder post uses Kevin's existing LinkedIn profile or waits for a Mythical Void company Page.
If creating the Page, check the proposed LinkedIn public URL is available before confirming it.
If reserving YouTube, confirm YouTube is enabled on the existing Google Account and check the proposed handle is available.
Turn on multi-factor authentication and keep recovery details outside the repository.
Provide only the finished public URL; never paste a password or recovery code.
Name a backup owner before publishing from an official company channel.
Approve the complete first-post preview and a 48-hour response-coverage window.
